item.description: The warming temperatures may have thawed out the Texas Tundra, but the Boys Power Rankings remain nearly frozen in place heading into February.The Top 7 teams stayed right where they were as they all nearly swept the week. item.title: THE POWER RANKINGS: Melee for second as Westlake overpowers Austin area Girls squads
item.description: Westlake is at it again. The undefeated Lady Chaparrals (32-0) once again crushed two ranked, 20-win district foes to maintain their comfortable lead in this week’s Austin area Girls Power Rankings.It’s a madhouse behind them, however. Glenn avenged and earlier loss to Liberty Hill to move up to #2 for now, but that battle might be decided in the playoffs.
